Here’s a quick‑look list of the long weekends that Canadians can expect in 2023, based on the federal statutory holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday. (If you’re looking at a specific province, keep in mind that some holidays—like Family Day, Good Friday, and the “Civic Holiday”—vary by region.)

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday (Federal/Provincial) | Notes |
|--------------------|-----------------------------|-------|
| **Feb 18–20** | **Family Day** (Ontario) | Ontario’s Family Day is the third Monday in February. |
| **Mar 18–20** | **Family Day** (most other provinces) | Most provinces observe Family Day on the third Monday in March. |
| **Apr 7–9** | **Good Friday** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in many provinces (e.g., BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, NL, PEI, NS, NT, NU, YT). |
| **May 20–22** | **Victoria Day** | A federal holiday that falls on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Aug 5–7** | **Civic Holiday** (many provinces) | First Monday in August; observed in most provinces except ON, QC, NB, PEI, NS, NL, YT, NT, NU. |
| **Sep 2–4** | **Labour Day** | A federal holiday that falls on the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | **Thanksgiving** | A federal holiday that falls on the second Monday in October. |
| **Dec 23–25** | **Christmas Day** | A federal holiday that falls on the first Monday in December. |

### Quick recap of the federal holidays that create long weekends in 2023

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|--------------|---------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | No |
| Family Day (ON) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Yes |
| Good Friday (many provinces) | Apr 7 (Fri) | Yes |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | Yes |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | No |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Yes |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Yes |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) | No |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Yes |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tue) | No |

> **Tip for your holiday‑planning app:**  
> If you want to support province‑specific holidays, you’ll need to add the following:
> - **Family Day** on the third Monday in March for most provinces (except ON).  
> - **Civic Holiday** on the first Monday in August for most provinces.  
> - **Good Friday** for provinces that observe it (BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, NL, PEI, NS, NT, NU, YT).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of statutory holidays for each province or if you’d like me to calculate the exact weekend ranges using the `add` or `multiply` functions!
